svg.aria-label: How PM2.5 travels through the body: fine particles about 30 times smaller than a human hair are breathed in and cross from the lungs into the bloodstream, reaching the brain (stroke, dementia), lungs (asthma, COPD, cancer), heart (heart attack, arrhythmia), kidneys (lower eGFR), and pregnancy (preterm birth, low birth weight).
svg.text: How PM2.5 travels through your body
particles ~30× smaller than a hair — small enough to cross into the blood
Not just a lung problem — PM2.5 reaches nearly every organ in the body.
